description:
About the job

All candidates from LATAM countries are welcome to apply!!




About the Role

As a CRO / Website Optimization Specialist, you will own a client's website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap from opportunity identification through execution and analysis. This is not a strategy-only position: you will formulate hypotheses, build and launch tests yourself, analyze performance, and determine what should happen next.

You'll have meaningful autonomy across Shopify, landing pages, quizzes, cart optimization, analytics, and experimentation tools. The right person combines strong CRO judgment with the technical confidence to make changes independently without relying on the client to finish or troubleshoot the execution.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.




Responsibilities

Own the website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on customer behavior, data, and potential conversion impact.
Turn conversion opportunities into clear hypotheses with defined success metrics and a rationale for why each test is worth running.
Personally build, QA, and launch A/B tests using Intelligems or comparable experimentation platforms.
Make Shopify front-end changes independently, including landing page updates, merchandising improvements, UX changes, and conversion-focused site enhancements.
Build and optimize landing pages rather than relying solely on designers or developers to execute your recommendations.
Improve quizzes and personalization funnels using Digioh or comparable tools to increase engagement and progression through the purchase journey.
Optimize cart and upsell experiences using Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify conversion tools.
Use GA4 and platform-level analytics to evaluate website behavior, conversion performance, event tracking, and experiment outcomes.
Translate experiment results into clear next steps, including follow-up tests, rollouts, iterations, or changes in roadmap priority.
Troubleshoot unfamiliar website and platform issues independently using documentation, support resources, AI tools, and structured problem-solving.




Requirements

Must-Have:

3-6+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, e-commerce website optimization, growth, or a closely related role, with flexibility for candidates whose experience demonstrates equivalent depth.
Strong practical knowledge of e-commerce conversion optimization, including funnels, customer journeys, merchandising, UX, and key conversion levers.
Hands-on Shopify front-end experience with the ability to make and troubleshoot website changes independently.
Proven ownership of A/B testing from opportunity identification and hypothesis creation through implementation, analysis, and next-step recommendations.
Hands-on experience with Intelligems or a comparable experimentation platform, plus working knowledge of GA4 and website conversion analytics.
Ability to personally build landing pages and conversion experiences rather than only producing briefs for designers or developers.
Strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to follow detailed written or video instructions carefully when working with sensitive website or company information.




Nice to Have:

Experience using Digioh for quizzes, funnels, personalization, or comparable conversion experiences.
Experience with Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify upsell and cart-optimization tools.
Direct experience working with DTC e-commerce brands.
Experience optimizing subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Previous experience in a role that combined strategic CRO ownership with substantial hands-on execution.

About the job

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing US-Based pet brand selling innovative tools that have quickly become essentials in millions of homes.

Their products reach customers through their direct-to-consumer store and major retailers. Creator-led commerce—especially on TikTok Shop—is one of their fastest-growing acquisition channels.




Position Summary

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and creator-obsessed TikTok Shop Affiliate Specialist to support the daily operations and scaling of our creator program.

In this hands-on role, your primary mission is to ensure our affiliate pipeline never stalls. You will drive daily outreach, manage creator sample fulfillment, coordinate automated communications, moderate our creator community, and analyze short-form content patterns that generate revenue. Working directly with our Director of Content and Community, you will turn high-level campaign plans into consistent operational action that directly impacts month-over-month affiliate GMV.




Key Responsibilities

1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Operations

Support the day-to-day execution and operational health of the client's TikTok Shop affiliate program.
Build, launch, and optimize creator outreach campaigns and automated follow-up sequences using Cruva.
Review incoming sample requests, evaluating creators based on audience fit, content quality, and sales potential.

Monitor TikTok Shop account health, handle documentation, manage support tickets, and resolve operational roadblocks quickly.
Track program risks, performance gaps, and activation metrics, reporting insights directly to the Affiliate Marketing Manager.

2. Campaign Execution & Content Analysis

Help execute affiliate campaigns, creator contests, seasonal challenges, and performance incentives.
Clear campaign details, deadlines, and deliverables to creators; track participation and follow up to drive posting volume.

Translate winning content patterns into actionable creator briefs and share performance insights with internal teams.
Develop and test new campaign angles to reactivate dormant creators and underutilized communication channels.

3. Community Management & Engagement

Act as the frontline voice for the brand across TikTok Shop Affiliate Center Messages and our Creator Discord.
Foster an active, supportive creator community by posting announcements, content inspiration, challenge updates, and actionable tips.
Answer creator inquiries promptly, ensuring affiliates feel supported rather than treated as transactional partners.
Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline recurring reminders, updates, and creator follow-ups.

4. Ambassador, UGC & Social Strategy Support

Support the reactivation and ongoing management of our ambassador program via Upfluence.
Source UGC creators for scripted ad content, retail push campaigns, and new product launch initiatives.
Support the broader organic social strategy by scheduling approved short-form content in Later.
Edit raw UGC clips into platform-native, high-converting social posts across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing or supporting a TikTok Shop affiliate program for a CPG/consumer brand (outside of the fashion category).
Platform Knowledge: Proficiency with TikTok Shop Affiliate Center, short-form social platforms, and creator management software. Direct experience with Cruva, Upfluence, Discord, and Later is strongly preferred.
Content Literacy: Strong instincts for short-form video mechanics—you know what makes a compelling hook, a smooth product demo, and a converting call-to-action.
Technical Skills: Experience utilizing AI tools and workflows to automate repetitive creator communication and task management. Basic short-form video editing skills.
Soft Skills: Exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and strong written communication skills tailored for creator relationships.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Outreach & Activation: Consistency of creator outreach and speed of sample request processing.
Creator Participation: Increase in creator posting volume and participation rate in active campaigns.
Community Engagement: Response time and engagement levels within Discord and Affiliate Center messages.
Revenue Impact: Measurable contribution to overall month-over-month TikTok Shop affiliate GMV growth.

What We Offer

Work Environment: 100% Fully Remote work structure (US-based).
Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO) package plus quarterly flex days to recharge.
Career Growth: Professional development support and opportunities to grow within a high-growth e-commerce brand.

About the job

About the Role

You'll fully own the strategy and execution of lifecycle and transactional messaging across the user journey, from onboarding to winback, from product updates to re-engagement nudges. This is a full-ownership role reporting directly to the Director of Marketing and close collaboration with Analytics, Product, and Engineering. Your goal: drive activation, boost retention, and bring users back with communications that resonate.




In your first 90 days, you'll be expected to get up to speed on our current lifecycle program, identify opportunities for improvement, and begin acting on the highest priorities.




What You'll Do




Own the messaging strategy across the customer journey

Plan and maintain the roadmap for lifecycle and transactional communications, from onboarding to winback and everything in between, proactively surfacing new opportunities as you go.




Build and optimize communication flows

Create and manage journey logic using behavioral triggers, segmentation, and conditional rules, directly in platforms like Iterable and SendGrid. Propose new touchpoints and improve existing ones based on performance and insights.




Protect sender reputation and deliverability

Apply core deliverability practices — list hygiene, send warm-up, engagement-based segmentation, and monitoring — especially for large-volume sends, staying ahead of early warning signs of reputation or inbox-placement issues.




Own quality control end-to-end

Serve as the final check before anything reaches users — proofing copy, links, formatting, and rendering across devices. High attention to detail is essential, since errors caught after send affect real users and brand trust.




Own execution from brief to send

Write, build, and execute email content, layout, and visuals yourself, bringing in writers, designers, or AI tools when that's the faster or better path. You know what to send and why.




Leverage analytics to improve performance

Work closely with the Analytics team to track engagement, conversion, and retention. Use data to inform strategy, test hypotheses, and prioritize optimizations.




Stay sharp on tools and trends

Keep up with best practices in lifecycle marketing, experimentation, personalization, and platform capabilities.




What We're Looking For




Experience & Expertise

3–5+ years managing high-impact email marketing and lifecycle communications, ideally in a fast-paced B2C environment.
Experience emailing to a large-scale US consumer audience, with native or near-native fluency in English and a strong command of copywriting tailored to US consumer tone and expectations.
Solid working knowledge of email deliverability fundamentals — sender reputation, list hygiene, warm-up practices, and general best practices for maintaining inbox placement.
Proven track record of independently identifying problems and proposing solutions within a lifecycle program.
Hands-on experience with major platforms like Iterable, Braze, SendGrid, or similar.
Skilled in segmentation, personalization, automation, and journey logic for lifecycle campaigns.




Technical & Creative Skills

Strong messaging instincts. You know how to brief effective copy, give clear feedback, and make communications resonate.
Sharp eye for detail — comfortable QA-ing your own templates and catching issues (formatting, broken links, inconsistent tone) before anything goes live.
Familiar with email structure and layout; HTML skills preferred but not required, as AI and human HTML support is available.
Analytical thinker, comfortable reviewing dashboards, spotting trends, and turning insights into action.
Fluent with ChatGPT/Claude, integrating them naturally into your daily workflow for writing, editing, and problem-solving.
Curious and iterative — you like testing, learning, and improving what's already working.




Professional Strengths

Strategic thinker and hands-on doer, comfortable owning outcomes with support available as needed.
Self-motivated and reliable — takes initiative, communicates proactively, and stays organized in a remote, fast-moving startup environment.
Open to feedback and iterates quickly based on it.

description:
About the job

Job Overview

As an Engineering Manager at iCIMS, you will lead the delivery of enterprise software solutions that transform how organizations attract, engage, and hire talent.

You will be responsible for both technical excellence and the growth of your team, supporting projects from discovery through implementation and operation. You will partner closely with Product Management, Design, Architecture, Security, and other Engineering teams to evaluate technical needs, develop solution proposals, and present them to the appropriate stakeholders for review and approval.

Your leadership will contribute directly to the evolution of iCIMS’ global talent acquisition platform, including automation, conversational experiences, and responsible AI capabilities.

About Us

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end-to-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise-grade hiring technology, AI-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.

Responsibilities


Lead with purpose: Translate product and business needs into actionable engineering plans aligned with iCIMS’ strategy, architectural standards, and customer commitments. 
Propose technical solutions: Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate options, document trade-offs, and recommend scalable and secure technical solutions.
Present proposals for review and approval by the relevant architecture, product, and engineering stakeholders. 
Develop your team: Lead, coach, and support a team of four to six engineers, fostering autonomy, continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
Drive delivery and impact: Oversee the full project lifecycle, from technical discovery and planning through deployment and operation. Ensure approved solutions are delivered reliably and generate measurable value for customers and candidates.
Support sound decision-making: Identify risks, clarify dependencies, and provide recommendations in complex or ambiguous situations.

Strengthen the culture: Foster accountability, trust, transparency, flexibility, and inclusion. Lead by example and create an environment where people can do their best work.


Technical challenges you will face 


Developing and optimizing event-driven systems capable of processing millions of interactions involving candidates, job requisitions, and hiring workflows. 
Proposing reliable technical approaches for complex and highly configurable enterprise hiring processes. 
Building robust authentication, authorization, privacy, and data-protection capabilities. 
Evolving a platform used by global organizations while accounting for internationalization, localization, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 
Designing real-time communication tools and conversational experiences for candidates and talent teams. 
Incorporating automation and responsible AI while maintaining control, traceability, governance, and human oversight. 
Continuously improving the observability, resilience, performance, and operational readiness of services. 


Main Technologies 

Backend: Go, Python (Django, FastAPI)


Strong programming background, preferably with Go, but Django, FastAPI, and event-driven or microservices architectures are also desired.


Qualifications


At least four years of software development experience using modern programming languages. 
At least two years of hands-on, in-depth experience with Go; this is a required qualification.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively, influence decisions, and present technical proposals to global technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience designing scalable, resilient, and secure software and infrastructure. 
The ability to assess technical alternatives, explain trade-offs, and develop well-supported recommendations for stakeholder approval. 
Experience managing priorities, dependencies, and technical commitments across multiple teams. 
Strong organizational skills, humility, and a continuous-learning mindset.

Preferred


Experience with enterprise security, privacy, and compliance standards.

title: Analista Senior de Costos
description:
About the job

En DEVARANA creemos que los grandes proyectos se construyen con grandes equipos.




Somos una desarrolladora inmobiliaria México–Holandesa con más de 14 años de experiencia, especializada en proyectos de alto nivel en Querétaro. Trabajamos como una firma boutique, con estándares internacionales de diseño, ejecución y disciplina financiera.




En DEVARANA no hacemos volumen: hacemos proyectos exigentes, pensados con profundidad, ejecutados con rigor y destinados a elevar la forma de vivir.




Nuestros proyectos requieren algo más que conocimiento técnico: requieren precisión, criterio y responsabilidad sobre cada decisión que impacta el costo y la viabilidad del proyecto.

Hoy buscamos integrar a nuestro equipo a nuestro próximo:




ANALISTA DE COSTOS Y PRESUPUESTOS




¿Cuál será tu responsabilidad?

Tu trabajo será fundamental para convertir proyectos ejecutivos en información de costos confiable para la toma de decisiones.




PRESUPUESTACIÓN

• Elaborar presupuestos paramétricos, antepresupuestos y presupuestos ejecutivos.

• Desarrollar partidas completas de manera autónoma y participar en secciones específicas de acuerdo con la etapa del proyecto.

• Garantizar exactitud, orden y trazabilidad en cada entrega.




CUANTIFICACIÓN Y RENDIMIENTOS

• Elaborar y revisar generadores de obra en gabinete a partir de proyectos ejecutivos.

• Validar y conciliar las cuantificaciones generadas en Revit por el equipo de Arquitectura Ejecutiva contra los generadores propios.

• Analizar rendimientos de mano de obra y materiales para asegurar que los presupuestos reflejen condiciones reales de ejecución.




PRECIOS UNITARIOS E INGENIERÍA DE VALOR

• Generar y mantener actualizadas matrices de precios unitarios por partida y especialidad.

• Integrar insumos, rendimientos y gastos indirectos.

• Elaborar comparativas de precios e identificar oportunidades de optimización de costos sin comprometer la calidad del proyecto.




SEGUIMIENTO A CONTRATISTAS

• Analizar propuestas económicas de contratistas y su estructura de costos.

• Identificar desviaciones respecto al presupuesto base.

• Apoyar al Gerente de Costos y al área de Compras en procesos de negociación y cierre.




GESTIÓN DE INFORMACIÓN Y ERP

• Registrar y mantener actualizados los insumos de obra en los sistemas ERP y Enkontrol.

• Garantizar información precisa y oportuna para Costos, Compras y Dirección de Operaciones.




¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Buscamos una persona técnica, analítica y estructurada, que sepa y trabaje para hacer que un presupuesto no sea únicamente una suma de números: si no una herramienta para tomar decisiones de negocio.




Formación académica

• Licenciatura en Ingeniería Civil o Arquitectura. Titulado.

• Se considerarán candidatos de otras carreras únicamente cuando cuenten con experiencia técnica específica y comprobable en precios unitarios y costos.




Experiencia profesional

• 3 a 5 años de experiencia comprobable en presupuestos, costos o análisis de precios unitarios.

• Experiencia en obra privada.

• Buscamos experiencia específica en el área de costos y presupuestos; la experiencia exclusivamente en campo u obra no será suficiente para esta posición.




Competencias técnicas indispensables

• OPUS y/o NEODATA: mínimo 3 años de experiencia comprobable. Indispensable.

• AutoCAD: nivel intermedio-avanzado para lectura e interpretación de proyectos ejecutivos.

• Excel: manejo sólido para análisis, comparativas y control de información presupuestal.

• Revit / BIM: deseable; capacidad para leer y validar cuantificaciones provenientes del modelo.

• Enkontrol: deseable.




¿Qué buscamos en tu forma de trabajar?




Organización y planeación

Puedes trabajar con múltiples partidas, especialidades y proyectos sin perder precisión ni trazabilidad.




Sentido de urgencia

Entiendes que los tiempos de Costos impactan directamente las decisiones de toda la organización.




Autonomía y enfoque a resultados

No necesitas instrucciones para cada paso. Identificas lo que hace falta, investigas y avanzas.




Comunicación asertiva

Puedes explicar con claridad una desviación, una diferencia de precios o un supuesto técnico, incluso cuando las cifras están bajo revisión.




Excelencia y atención al detalle

Sabes que un error en un precio, rendimiento o cuantificación puede tener consecuencias reales en el proyecto.




Inteligencia emocional

Trabajas con compostura bajo presión y mantienes una comunicación profesional durante procesos de revisión, negociación y cierre.




Otros requisitos

• Residencia preferentemente en Querétaro.

• Se consideran candidatos de otros estados con disponibilidad para cambio de residencia.

• Inglés intermedio.

• Disponibilidad de tiempo completo.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Salario competitivo de acuerdo con experiencia y mercado.

• Bono de desempeño anual.

• Prestaciones superiores, incluyendo aguinaldo de 30 días, subsidio de comedor / vales de despensa, apoyo para actividades de bienestar, seguro de vida y SGMM.

• Integrarte a una empresa certificada Great Place to Work y ESR.

• Participar directamente en proyectos inmobiliarios de alto nivel, innovación y diseño en México.




¿Por qué DEVARANA?

Porque aquí tu trabajo no termina en elaborar un catálogo de conceptos.

Tus análisis, cuantificaciones, rendimientos y precios serán parte de las decisiones que determinan cuánto cuesta construir, dónde podemos optimizar y cómo protegemos la rentabilidad de nuestros proyectos.




Si tu talento pide un escenario donde se valore la precisión, el criterio técnico y la excelencia, nos gustaría conocerte.




Postúlate por LinkedIn y cuéntanos sobre los proyectos y presupuestos que has construido.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About the job

Powering the world’s payments ecosystem




ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.




Job Purpose




The Business Development Representative (BDR), LATAM is responsible for driving pipeline development and supporting new business growth across Latin America. Based in Mexico and working remotely, this role works in close alignment with the regional Sales organization while reporting into the Marketing team and partnering closely with the LATAM Marketing Manager.

The BDR serves as a critical link between Marketing and Sales by evaluating inbound leads, identifying and qualifying prospective opportunities, executing outbound prospecting campaigns, and scheduling meetings that create qualified sales conversations. Success in this role is measured by the ability to generate and qualify pipeline, accelerate lead progression, improve conversion rates, and create meaningful engagement opportunities for ACI's New Business sales teams.




Essential Functions and Responsibilities




- Partner closely with LATAM sales leaders, LATAM Marketing Manager and regional New Business sales teams to support pipeline generation and revenue growth.

- Evaluate inbound leads and inquiries to determine qualification, business fit, buying intent, and readiness for sales engagement.

- Conduct outreach to prospective customers through phone, email, social media, and other channels to generate qualified meetings and opportunities.

- Execute targeted outbound prospecting campaigns aligned with regional sales priorities and account-based marketing initiatives.

- Leverage AI-powered sales, research, and productivity tools to scale prospecting activities, identify buying signals, prioritize opportunities, personalize outreach, automate administrative tasks, and increase the effectiveness of pipeline generation efforts while adhering to ACI security, privacy, and governance standards.

- Schedule and coordinate meetings between qualified prospects and sales representatives.

- Build and manage prospect lists in collaboration with regional sales and marketing teams.

- Support lead nurturing activities and ensure timely follow-up on marketing-generated leads.

- Maintain accurate lead, contact, activity, and opportunity records within Salesforce and other sales and marketing platforms.

- Monitor lead progression and work closely with sales teams to improve conversion rates and pipeline velocity.

- Provide feedback to Marketing regarding campaign effectiveness, lead quality, messaging, and market trends.

About the job

About Klar

We're turning one of the world's largest underbanked markets into something fairer, simpler, and more transparent.

7 million users served since 2019. Uber's first global credit card, built right here in Mexico. Klar Empresarial, a brand-new B2B solution — Klar Empresarial — bringing agile credit and smart accounts to SMEs who've been ignored by traditional banks for too long. And a full banking license on the horizon, because our customers asked for it and we listened.

We move fast, we think big, and we go all in, because as our CEO puts it: "Growing doesn't always mean going further. Sometimes it means going deeper."

Behind all of it is a team of 30+ nationalities, working across Mexico City, Berlin, and Argentina, obsessed with building financial products that are simpler, faster, and fairer than anything that came before.

This is Klar, and we're seeking the people who'll write the next chapter.

Our people

If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team that is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here!

description:
About the job

Description

The Customer Success team is seeking a Digital Customer Success Manager (CSM) to support our customers throughout their lifecycle with our clients’ automation and digital journeys. The Digital CSM will work with Customer Success leadership to develop and implement a cohesive, strategic digital

approach to customer relationships and operations, ultimately leading to increased satisfaction and overall customer retention.

The Digital CSM is responsible for executing on the Digital customer journey, capturing, analyzing and actioning data, sharing feedback and identifying areas of opportunity for improvements to the customer journey. The Digital CSM will work to ensure positive engagement with our customer’s platform, and drive adoption and success outcomes, ultimately influencing retention, expansion, and advocacy.

Requirements



Bachelor’s Degree and 3+ years’ experience in a customer success or customer support role with proven operations or technical expertise.
Excellent communication (written and verbal).
Passion for designing processes that scale.
Ability to break down problems and think through optimal solutions.
Strong listening skills; open to input from other team members and/or departments.
Strong multi-tasking, organizational, and prioritization skills; high attention to detail.
Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts and derive solutions across multiple product lines.
Ability to quickly learn and perform in new software environments.
Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Operations)
Proficiency in Excel, MS Office and Salesforce.com.
High degree of emotional intelligence and empathy.
Strong understanding of corporate business world; prior experience in a SaaS preferred
Customer-centric, can-do attitude with a strong sense of urgency and proactive approach to anticipating and resolving issues.



Job responsibilities



Create and execute on the Digital Customer Journey to maximize Customer Success coverage across full Motus account base.
 Outline customer lifecycle by determining the timing and content of touchpoints along the customer journey to drive adoption, customer satisfaction and retention.
Respond to customer outreach with a positive, customer-centric attitude.
Provide education and coaching to drive product adoption and maximize product value for customers.
Field customer inquiries and direct the resolution of any issues that arise, engaging the appropriate internal teams (Product, Ops, Member Services, Customer Care, etc.) as necessary to ensure proactive and timely resolution of client issues.
Employ a consultative approach in discussions with customers to understand their goals and success measures. Establish a plan to ensure we are meeting the agreed upon goals using digital engagement technologies.
Meet and exceed team and individual key performance indicators.
Identify continuous improvements and enhancements within digital journey and create necessary documentation.
Research and implement new digital engagement techniques, utilizing digital customer success best practices.
Adhere to team process and identify/execute on team process improvements.
Work closely with Customer Success leadership, Gainsight Administrator and Operations team to assess effectiveness of new functionality and identify improvements.
Serve as a customer advocate while capturing customer feedback and reporting requests to Product and Engineering.
Think creatively to solve customer problems.
Identify ways to expand outreach to customers using automation (webinars, newsletters, surveys, etc.).
Develop and share best practices with team members to continually improve the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of our processes.
Identify successful Digital campaigns and implement across high-touch Customer Success cohort, including enablement of high-touch CSMs.



What we offer

Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to work on market-defining products using the latest technologies.

Collaborative Environment:Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance:GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules.We offer you the best quality of work life so that you exceed the expectations of our clients, while achieving your professional and personal ambitions.

Professional Development:Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes English classes, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. We also offer the chance to travel internationally

Excellent Benefits:We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, extended paternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

description:
About the job

About Netafim:

At Netafim, we work side by side with millions of farmers and communities around the world to address one of agriculture’s most pressing challenges: how to produce more food with fewer resources in an increasingly unpredictable environment. For more than 60 years, Netafim has been a global leader in precision irrigation, powered by people working across teams and geographies to bring together agronomy, engineering, data, and innovation.

Together, we help improve decision-making in the field and drive better outcomes across crops and climates — turning complexity into clarity and making agriculture more precise, efficient, and sustainable to enable farmers to grow more with less.

Position Overview

We are looking for a dedicated, energetic, and technically curious Customer Success Representative to support our Digital Farming (GrowSphere) customers. This role is focused on proactive customer engagement, onboarding, education, and ongoing support to help growers get the most value from their automation and digital farming tools.

This position serves as a primary point of contact for new and existing customers. Primarily through scheduled phone and virtual meetings, ensuring they understand how to use the GrowSphere platform and feel confident incorporating it into their daily operations. The ideal candidate enjoys teaching, problem‑solving, and working with innovative agricultural technology while building strong, professional relationships with growers.

The majority of time will be spent at a desk managing customer calls and follow‑ups, with opportunities to participate in field visits, troubleshooting, equipment testing, and sales or support meetings when call volume allows.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Success


Proactively schedule and conduct onboarding sessions for new Digital Farming customers.
Maintain regular follow‑ups with existing customers to review system usage, adoption, and overall success.
Serve as a trusted resource to help growers understand and effectively utilize the GrowSphere platform.
Communicate clearly and professionally with growers of varying technical comfort levels, adapting your approach to each operation.
Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes through better system usage, education, or configuration.


Technical Support & Escalation


Provide basic troubleshooting and guidance for the GrowSphere operating system and connected equipment.
Identify customers who require additional technical or in‑field support and escalate appropriately to internal teams.
Recognize when on‑farm visits or advanced support are needed and coordinate handoff to the correct resource.
Participate in field visits, testing, and troubleshooting activities when appropriate.


Growth Identification & Internal Collaboration


Identify customers who may benefit from expanding or optimizing their Digital Farming systems.
Clearly document and pass qualified expansion opportunities to the appropriate Key Account Manager.
Work closely with sales, technical, and field teams to ensure a smooth customer experience and clear internal communication.


CRM & Process Management


Accurately document all customer interactions, notes, action items, and follow‑ups in the CRM system.
Manage a pipeline of scheduled calls, follow‑ups, and inbound customer inquiries.
Track customer engagement and recurring themes to support continuous improvement efforts.


Minimum Qualifications


Ability to read, write, and speak English clearly and professionally.
Spanish language skills are a strong plus.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Comfortable spending a majority of the workday on phone calls and virtual meetings.
Proficient with, or willing to learn, CRM systems.
Proficient with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and stay organized.
Able to work indoors and outdoors as needed and follow safety and operational guidelines.


Preferred Education & Experience


High School Diploma or equivalent required.
Agricultural degree or coursework preferred.
Experience in agriculture, irrigation, ag technology, or related fields strongly preferred.
Previous experience in customer success, customer support, technical support, or account coordination is a plus.


Skills & Competencies


Technically savvy with an interest in agricultural technology and automation.
Strong problem‑solving and prioritization skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear, practical, and grower‑friendly way.
Detail‑oriented with strong documentation habits.
Comfortable working across teams and escalating issues when appropriate.


Desired Traits


Self‑motivated, dependable, and team‑oriented.
Positive attitude with a genuine desire to help customers succeed.
Enjoys teaching, learning, and continuous improvement.
Curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic ag environment.


About Orbia:

Orbia Advance Corporation is a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in the Polymer Solutions, Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor & Energy Materials sectors. The five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on ensuring food and water security, expanding information access and connectivity, and advancing decarbonization and the energy transition with basic and advanced materials, specialty products, and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 22,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with a strong U.S. manufacturing presence and headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam, and Tel Aviv. The company generated $7.6 billion in revenue in 2025. To learn more, visit: orbia.com

We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

A curious, persistent, and action-oriented approach, with the ability to take ownership of outcomes across an entire brand.

About the job

Who We Are

ABOUT ENOVIS™

Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com.

What You'll Do

Revenue Operations Analyst, GPO

About The Role

Revenue Operations sits between sales, marketing, finance and operations, turning data into decisions. As the GPO Analyst you own the group purchasing organization side of that work: membership rosters, contract eligibility, pricing accuracy, and the tracings and rebates reporting that sales leadership depends on.

You will be the go-to person internally for anything related to hospital and member affiliations, and the main contact for distribution partners when pricing or submissions need to be sorted out. A lot of this data is confidential, so accuracy and integrity matter as much as speed.

This role reports to the Manager, Revenue Operations.

What You Will Do


Manage and maintain GPO membership rosters, keeping member information and GPO relationships current and verified
Process, prepare and distribute tracings and rebate reports, including validating contract eligibility and handling resubmissions
Work with distribution partners to collect tracings data, calculate rebates owed, and present the results to sales management
Track member performance against purchase commitments and confirm they are in the right pricing tiers
Review and validate GPO pricing requests, and keep internal and external pricing systems aligned with negotiated contracts
Build reports and analytics in Power BI and Excel that sales leadership uses to make strategic calls
Resolve pricing discrepancies, credit and rebill requests, and other partner issues
Maintain customer and rep databases for sales reporting (CRM, lead tracking, competitor impact, market share) at corporate, divisional and territory level
Represent Revenue Operations in cross functional projects with IT, Finance, Marketing, Sales, HR, Customer Care and Compliance


What You Need


BA/BS in Business, Finance, Economics or Accounting
At least 2 years in Revenue Operations or a similar finance role
Strong Excel, including PivotTables
Solid organizational and communication skills, and the ability to explain data clearly to people who are not analysts
Comfortable running multiple projects independently against tight deadlines
Experience working across teams and business units
Able to thrive in a fast paced environment where priorities shift


Nice to have


MBA
Experience with ERP systems, Access or other databases, and Salesforce
Power BI reporting experience


How We Work

We look for people who are accurate and thorough, who dig into a problem before jumping to a solution, and who make the team around them better. You will also be expected to follow the Enovis Compliance & Ethics Program, the Enovis Code of Conduct, the Sales and Marketing Code of Conduct, and the AdvaMed Code of Ethics.

Kindly upload your English resume.

We value the unique contributions that every employee brings to their role with Enovis.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future

At Salesloft, our Senior Corporate Accountant will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing accounting team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the smooth and accurate operation of our corporate accounting and payroll functions across multiple countries, including the US, Mexico, the UK, Poland, India, and other potential markets. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment while further developing your skills in US GAAP accounting, international accounting, US and international payroll processing, tax compliance, and financial reporting.

As a Senior Corporate Accountant, you'll be responsible for various aspects of corporate accounting and end-to-end payroll administration, including US multi-state payroll, international payroll coordination, tax compliance, financial reporting, and general ledger activities.You will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our financial records. This includes processing domestic and global payroll cycles, preparing financial reports, overseeing specific accounting processes such as accounts payable, fixed assets, and accruals, and providing guidance to other team members. You will also be involved in liaising with external auditors, payroll vendors, and supporting internal controls.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to be a strategic contributor to our public-readiness journey in a fast-paced goal-oriented accounting and finance department. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a detail-oriented, extremely thorough, and very diligent Senior Corporate Accountant who enjoys working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more within corporate accounting, then this is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Salesloft’s Accounting & Finance team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming accounting and finance professionals.

The Accounting and Finance team consists of results-oriented SaaS accounting professionals with strong analytical skills ensuring timely and accurate records in accordance with company accounting policies and generally accepted accounting principles. The accountants on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about redefining the Revenue Orchestration space and activating the authentic seller in all of us.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
5+ years of progressive corporate accounting experience
Comfortable working on a fast-paced team with changing priorities within a high-growth company
Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills to interact with various levels of management and build influential relationships with partners in the business
Positive attitude with a high level of eagerness and aptitude to learn new technology and practices
Demonstrated ability to multi-task and balance numerous priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
Strong knowledge of Excel, with experience in NetSuite a plus
Hands-on experience processing US multi-state payroll, including federal, state, and local tax filings (Forms 941, W-2, state equivalents)
Experience coordinating or processing international payroll across multiple countries (e.g., UK, Mexico, Poland, India), including working with in-country payroll vendors or PEO providers
Knowledge with US GAAP and international accounting principles


Familiarity with payroll compliance requirements, including garnishments, equity compensation taxation, and expatriate/shadow payroll concepts is a plus

About the job




🚀 Job Opportunity: 




National Alliance Manager (OEM & Dealer Network)

At MStar, we are scaling our footprint as a premier automotive ecosystem and embedded finance platform in Mexico. Backed by global investment funds, we are looking for a high-performing National Alliance Manager to drive our expansion across national automotive networks, forge strategic partnerships with OEMs, and accelerate credit adoption at the point of sale.




If you have a proven track record in automotive finance, dealership network management (F&I), and B2B commercial negotiations, and you thrive on scaling financial product penetration in floor-room environments, we want to hear from you!




📍 Role Overview 

Location: Mexico City (On-site at Paseo de la Reforma offices, near BMV)
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Seniority Level: Mid-Senior Level (5–10+ years) 
Language Requirements: Spanish (Native/Primary) + Professional English




🎯 Role Positioning Reporting to the Head of Business Development (Caleb Varner), you will lead our national dealership and OEM alliance strategy. Your main focus will be penetrating major dealership groups, aligning brand-captive financiers (OEMs), and training floor sales teams to drive high-volume credit placement using MStar's financial platform.




📋 Key Responsibilities 

National Network Expansion: Build, manage, and expand commercial relationships with auto dealership groups, OEM captives, and F&I directors across Mexico. 
Credit Adoption & Sales Enablement: Implement floor-room adoption strategies, incentive frameworks, and commission programs for dealership sales agents to maximize daily credit quoting. 
Strategic Deal Structuring: Negotiate co-marketing and joint-venture frameworks with dealership owners and regional brand directors to position MStar as the preferred financing partner. 
Cross-Functional Operations: Partner with Risk, Product, and Operations teams to streamline the onboarding journey, reduce credit approval friction, and ensure high conversion rates.




📊 Key Metrics / KPIs • Credit Penetration Rate: 

Percentage of total vehicle sales financed via MStar in assigned dealership networks. 
Active Dealership Rate: Weekly active quoting and application volume per dealership group. 
Volume & Portfolio Quality: Total Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of placed auto loans and overall conversion speed.




👤 Target Persona & Ideal Background 

Experience: 5+ years in Commercial Management, B2B Partnerships, or F&I Direction within Auto Financing, Banking (Crédito Automotriz), or Major Automotive Dealership Groups (e.g., Santander, Honda Finance, Dalton). 
Skills: Deep understanding of dealership economics, F&I operations, direct C-level negotiation with dealership owners, and a proven ability to lead sales enablement on the floor. 
Languages: Spanish (Native) and Professional English.




📩 How to Apply 

Apply directly by attaching your resume or send a direct message to discuss compensation, bonus structures, and growth plans.
